description: Retires one table from its dataset: it leaves the dataset's table list and frees its name for a new table. The versions it built are not deleted. The service confirms the archive with the table's current stored name itself, so you never send one. Example: {"table_id": "…"}. A live table is refused — call demote_table first. A table with a run still queued, held or running is refused too: cancel_run that run or wait for it to finish. Only call it when the person you are working for has asked for it. Returns {table_id, dataset_id, name, status, dashboard_url}.
name: archive_table
title: Archive a table
